nodes.notes: toEmail accepts one or more addresses separated by commas, e.g. first@example.com, second@example.com. Recipients share one message and can see the To list. Credential connections are unchanged. The configured page budget is 80 per run; this is an internal workload limit, not a provider free-tier page allowance.

nodes.notes: Bind a Header Auth credential: Authorization = Bearer <your Tavily key>.

nodes.name: Gemini - evidence extraction

nodes.name: SMTP - live digest
nodes.notes: Bind your SMTP credential. Automatic retries are disabled to avoid resending after an ambiguous send outcome.

parameters.content:
# Live Hackathon Radar

**Manual Trigger → real research → real email.**
**Daily schedule → the same live research workflow.**

No sample data or preview branches.

Your configured email addresses and credential connections are preserved.

Run from Manual Trigger whenever you want. Manual live runs start fresh and can repeat opportunities already emailed.

Scheduled research starts 07:30 IST; its email is held until 08:00 IST. Manual emails send when research finishes.

Imported inactive: enable the schedule after checking a real manual execution. Do not overlap live runs.

nodes.notes: This is a personal export retaining the credential references from your supplied workflow. The actual credential secrets stay in your n8n instance.

nodes.name: Remember scheduled results
nodes.notes: Automatic built-in memory only. n8n persists static data after a successful published production execution. Manual runs do not save history. No setup required.
